The question we work on

What stands between a real opportunity and a spendable payment?

01

Useful work
A task someone already needs.

02

Practical access
Clear terms. Lower barriers.

03

Money people can use
Payment after costs, with evidence.

This is our test for progress. Technology earns its place by helping people move through it.

Our north star

Eliminating human poverty.
One evidenced step at a time.

Credit, guarantees, AI agents and open-source infrastructure are tools we can test. Useful economic opportunity and measurable human benefit guide the choices.

Where we begin

Work that exists.
Barriers we can remove.

We start with a real task and a real payer. Then we examine what makes it difficult to participate, complete the work, or receive usable payment.

01

Check the original employer, current availability, eligibility and payment terms before presenting an opportunity.

Continuity, with a clearer test

We began with fair access to credit.
We are following the evidence toward opportunity.

Omnequa's first discovery phase explored open blockchain infrastructure for public benefit, including credit, universal basic income and local economies. That phase concluded in September 2026. Our next chapter applies its lessons to access to useful work and earnings.
